By using Spiritaxi services, the user acknowledges full awareness of these risks and agrees to assume them voluntarily. It is the sole responsibility of each user to ensure they are adequately trained, equipped, and protected before engaging in hunting activities. Use of the service constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of these terms, with no possibility of claims against Spiritaxi, its drivers, or any affiliated entities, whether material or spiritual.

sections.header:
//////////////////////// SPIRIMONZ ABILITIES ////////////////////////////
(*Words between * * are highlighted in-game*)

entries.value: Pigfire's flame turns blue as the surrounding temperature drops. It turns purple if the *temperature is freezing*.
The Pigfire flame can be used to light *candles* that the evil spirit could *blow out*.
When you activate Ghostball continuously in your hand, it reveals the *spectral imprints* around you.
Ghostball needs time to recover energy after using its power.
Leafball runs away at the first opportunity to hide a fruit from you in the house. The evil spirit can *eat this fruit*.
When following you, Fennelec can detect *spirit activities* and display their value on its ears.
Fennelec's cry irritates the ghost if it is nearby.
Blobhat detects *radioactivity* in the room after a spirit hunt.
Blobhat is likely to detect *radioactivity* when the malicious spirit passes through it.
Candleghost is itself a *candle* that the malicious spirit can *extinguish*.
Candle ghost reveals *spectral imprints* around him.
Frogball detects *spirit activities* around you and displays its value on its belly.
Feed Pyjamag with items for a chance to get *fruit* that the evil spirit *can eat*.
The sensor on Yeti allows you to calculate the *ambient temperature* in real time.
Yeti growls when the evil spirit passes through him.
Portebonoeil can protect you from an attack; it bursts into flames and disappears if the evil spirit attempts to start a hunt near it.
Portebonoeil's flames turn green if the malevolent spirit it stopped shows *radioactivity*.
When you activate Skullnobyl continuously in your hand, it reveals if there is *radioactivity* around you.
Skullnobyl needs time to recover energy after using its power.
Malinox causes a *magic fruit* to appear somewhere in the level. The *magic fruit* has increased priority for nearby hostile spirits to interact with it.
If you haven't found Malinox's magic fruit yet, ask him whether you're getting warmer or colder.
When Dragolt swallows an object that the malevolent spirit has recently interacted with, he can determine its *activity value*.
Dragolt can sometimes detect *activity with a value of 5* instead of activity with a value of 4 if the malicious spirit has the potential to do so.
When Dragolt swallows a *candle*, he spits it out again and *it is lit*.
Yudako haunts a room that isn't the evil spirit's favorite room, and if possible, not a neighboring room either.
Yudako detects paranormal *activity* over a long range and records the *activity levels* she has detected on small cards.
Shehapear wanders around the house and sometimes makes *fruit* appear.
Shehapear makes a sound when she senses the presence of an evil spirit around her; the spirit can leave an invisible mark on her apron.
By activating his power, Runedrake can *light candles* that the malevolent spirit might *extinguish*.
The candles lit by Runedrake glow in a range of colors from red to blue to yellow, revealing the *temperature* of the room they're in. If they turn pink, the *temperature is freezing*.
When Doghost barks, it reveals all the *spiritual prints* within a wide radius around it.
Doghost barks every time he hears the malevolent spirit interacting with a door or when you interact with him.
Doghost senses danger approaching and disappears just in time, before the malevolent spirit begins its hunt.
You can activate Muddyboo's ability to shoot sticky mud at flat surfaces, which drains its energy. Its energy replenishes very slowly.
Muddyboo's sticky mud can detect *radioactivity* and reveal *spiritual prints*.
Pakka will only sit in the coldest rooms of the house.
If Pakka is sitting in a *freezing cold* room, he falls asleep...
When Pakka falls asleep, he summons a unique gri-gri. If the room is a bathroom, the gri-gri is more valuable.
The spirit can move faster in its favorite room.
The spirit cannot turn off the water.
The temperature is dropping very slowly.
The spirit may choose to haunt a room that was originally warmer.
The spirit cannot turn on the water.
The spirit cannot turn on the light.
The spirit is faster when searching for you than when chasing you.
The evil spirit is slow when it is searching for you, but very fast when it has found you.
When this spirit finds you, its hunt duration is extended.
A Draconic Spirimonz never takes the form of an evil little spirit.
The spirit does not start a hunt outside of its favorite room.
The spirit opens doors more slowly when hunting.
The spirit cannot turn off the lights.
The spirit opens doors faster when hunting.
The spirit can throw objects farther than others.
This spirit does not trigger level 1 ghostly activity.
The spirit only starts a hunt if it is very angry.
The spirit doesn't need to be very angry to start a hunt.
The hunts of this spirit last longer.
This spirit cannot turn on electrical devices or lights.
There is a 10% chance that a hunt will begin after a grigri is picked up in the house it haunts.
The evil spirit tends to create interactions more often.
The evil spirit moves very quickly when searching for the player.
The evil spirit chooses to interact primarily with objects that can be broken.
This spirit cannot turn off electrical devices or lights.
You have identified the evil spirit!
'As soon as I see a door opening by itself, I rush over to see if I can find any Spirit Imprints using a blue light! '
But sometimes it's just one of my Spirits who opened the door...
It seems that before the Spirimonz appeared, half of the day was lit up by a huge ball of fire instead of the moon!
Have you noticed that my paintings are often found in haunted houses?
Malicious spirits love my work so much, it's great!
If you see your Spirimonz turning into orbs, it's high time to hide!
Some Spirimonz can sense danger earlier, before the evil spirit starts hunting you down...
Most hunters hope to detect activities of spirits with a value of 5 in order to advance their investigation...
...But some people tend to ignore the fact that a value of 1 tells us that it cannot be the work of a psychic mind!
The best way to find out if the evil spirit is emitting radiation is to provoke a hunt!
After that, it's important to hide well, avoid being caught, and then check the room where the malicious spirit has stopped its hunt!
I've never seen a Spirimonz sleep... Except for the Pakka, I'm always sleepy.
I captured this Pigfire, it was angry in the form of a Blazing-type malicious spirit!
I could have captured it by encountering a Demonic spirit, because every Spirimonz has two types!
Have you noticed that some Spirimonz don't want to leave our hands, while others are more independent?
'Personally, I like to sit my Spirimonz in rooms while I investigate elsewhere. '
I stopped trying to capture Spirimonz. Every time I paid to enter a haunted house, I got knocked out and lost my money!
I'll just stick with my Blobhat and that'll be fine!
The best way to make money is to find charms in haunted houses, even if sometimes you don't find any...
...And if we manage to free the Spirimonz from its malevolent spirit form by capturing it, the charms become more valuable!
When I investigate a malevolent spirit and want to check if it likes fruit, I have my own little technique!
I place a piece of fruit where I think the spirit lurks and remove other objects from the vicinity!
This way, there is a greater chance that he will decide to interact with the fruit, and hopefully eat it... or not!
My grandfather taught me a technique for hunting Spirimonz...
Apparently, one candle per room is more than enough!
I dug out my old Spirimonz hunter outfit again!
I hope there won't be any stairs in the next haunted house I visit...
Catching Spirimonz is fun, but taking on a real challenge is even better.
Are you in? It's not that expensive...
I get the feeling you're a beginner... Come back and see me when you can beat at least 15 Spirimonz...
So, do we want a little change in the Spirimonz team?
Spiritaxis are honored to be able to take the hunters of Spirimonz to more exotic destinations!
You can practice as much as you want in my fake haunted house. I'll give you a small prize if you win but I only have one Spirimonz to give you...
In real haunted houses, you might find any kind of Spirimonz. The one you get depends on the type of evil spirit you spot!

Otherwise, access to the house next door is free, but it’ll be a little harder! The reward will be greater, and you’ll be able to find \"gri-gris\", charms that will increase the final value of your winnings.
Feel free to ask anyone if you want more tips on how to play.
I hope you're ready for your first hunting lesson in Spirimonz.
Let's take it one step at a time. First, you'll need to learn how to interact with your surroundings...
Try turning on at least 3 different lights at the same time!
Great, we can see a little better now... But I'm going to turn off the lights, and this time we'll use candles.
Look for a candle and pick it up, there must be one somewhere...
This is important because it's one of the three pieces of evidence you need to gather to figure out what kind of spirit you're dealing with!
Great, you found one! Place it on a table using [Drop]. And I want that candle to stay upright!
We're finally going to need your first Spirimonz!
Equip your first Spirimonz using [Inventory2]. And drop it inside the house using [DropSpmz].
Your Spirimonz has a flame on its head, we can use it to light our candles!
Carry it with [PickupSpmz] to a candle in position, or use a candle with [Secondary] above its head.
It’s common to ask a Spirimonz to sit down somewhere so it doesn’t follow you everywhere.
You can pick up your Spirimonz again with [PickupSpmz].
I'm going to blow out a candle to make it look like the evil spirit blew one out.
You'll be able to note in your investigation log that the malevolent spirit is capable of blowing out candles.
Great! Now we just have to wait and see if the evil spirit will blow out those candles! SPOILER: There’s no evil spirit here, it’s just a tutorial...
Now that you understand how it works, use your second Spirimonz with [Inventory2], place it down, and try to detect paranormal activity in the house.
I'm going to use a remote control to trigger some activities to simulate the presence of a ghost. Find the room I've decided to “haunt” from afar!
You're doing great! If you've ever witnessed a level 5 paranormal activity, it means you've found evidence of a “Spirit Activity 5\".
Now let's go back to your first Spirimonz—it can detect cold coins because the color of its flame changes depending on the temperature.
The flame is red when it's very hot, then turns orange, yellow, green, blue... And if it's REALLY freezing, it turns pink!
Walk around the house with your Spirimonz and try to find the coldest room. Stay there to see if the temperature drops to freezing!
Great, we're making progress! Now I want you to find some spiritual footprints!
Get your third Spirimonz using [Inventory4]. You'll see, some Spirimonz can't be placed on the ground and have to stay in your hand.
Use this ability by holding down [Secondary]. This will reveal fingerprints on certain doors or pieces of furniture that the malevolent spirit has interacted with.
Be careful, sometimes your Spirimonz runs out of energy and needs a break.
Okay, so we've gathered three pieces of evidence? At this point, we'd normally know what kind of spirit we're dealing with. But we're going to keep going to uncover the rest of the evidence.
Take this apple and leave it in the room you think is haunted by the spirit; it should pique its interest.
I've tweaked this feature; it should work without any issues.
Not bad! Now let's tackle the only proof that doesn't require the help of the Spirimonz.
Press [Inventory1] to deselect any Spirimonz, and hold down [Secondary] to use your night-vision watch.
If you see glowing orbs through the watch screen in the haunted room, that means you've found more evidence!
One last clue to deal with! If you ever get hunted by the malevolent spirit, there’s a good chance it’ll leave behind a radioactive room where it finished its hunt!
Equip your latest Spirimonz with [Inventory5] and use its ability with [Secondary] to detect the irradiated rooms. I've simulated radiation in one of the rooms!
Now, what you need to understand is that each type of evil spirit responds to only three of these proofs.
If you figure out which ones, you’ll be able to free the evil spirit and turn it back into a friendly Spirimonz that you can add to your team.
Before I leave you to fend for yourself and let the spirits give you a hard time, I’m going to stage a hunt. I’ll be disguised as a spirit.
So hide well, because soon I'll pop up out of nowhere and try to find you!
If you get out of my line of sight by hiding behind something or in a closet, you'll have a better chance of getting away!
When you're out hunting, I also recommend turning off your flashlight using [Light], because the flashing gives away your position!
And of course, the mischievous spirit—in this case, me—is more likely to start its hunt in the haunted room... But I'm sure you already guessed that!
Well, you did pretty well... for a beginner.
Now it's your turn. I'm going to keep playing hide-and-seek. Watch out, or I'll catch you.
The door is open, so feel free to leave if you want, but when I'm out hunting, the door will be locked—just like in real life!
If you can figure out which type of evil spirit I'm imitating, I'll give you a Spirimonz, just as if you'd actually caught it!
Well, that's not quite it, I managed to catch you...
Let's try again, but this time, be smarter...
Check the "Freezing Temperature" evidence in the Journal.
Search the cupboards using [Interact] and pick up a candle using [Grab]
Found the haunted room and detect 2 spiritual activities. Use [Inventory3] to pick up your second spirimonz and walk around the house with him on your side.
Place the apple in the haunted room so the ghost can eat it.
Return to the haunted room to check the temperature. Your Spirimonz's flame will turn blue if it's cold, and then pink if it's freezing.
It's time to leave the house.
Turn on at least 3 different lights at the same time.
Use your third Spirimonz with [Inventory4] and reveal spirit prints in the haunted room by holding down [Secondary].
Check the "Spirit Orbs" evidence in the Journal.
Check the "Eat fruits" evidence in the Journal.
Ask your Spirimonz to wait by tapping on it with [InteractSpmz].
